text:
maria: Heads up — after yesterday's partial rollback we observed a tokenization edge-case on quantized LLMs in eu-west. I'm requesting a short holdback (runtime pin) for the quant model family while we stabilize. Proposing 4h starting now. @deploy-bot can you apply?

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Applying temporary runtime holdback (pin) as requested.
Pin details: pin-id=pin-1759999999-qt scope=runtime selected-version=3.14.1 region=eu-west duration=4h owner=maria

raj: Thanks. Quick Qs: what telemetry do we want to monitor to decide lift vs extend?

lina: Focus on three signals: decode error rate (long sequences), KV-cache miss rate, and token-level latency tail. Also watch the canary synthetic suite for hallucination/regression checks.

kevin: I'll spin up a canary run in eu-central and us-east with the quant test-suite, synthetic load ~10 rps, seq len=4096. Will post IDs when ready.

maria: Thanks Kevin. Also add an automated check to fail early if decode errors > 0.5% over 5m.

kevin: Canary started — canary-id=canary-1760000021 targets=[eu-central,us-east] test-suite=quant-regress-v2 threshold=0.5%

deploy-bot: Pin is active and visible in the pinboard. To inspect: `GET /api/pins/pin-1759999999-qt`

raj: For ops reference, quick diagnostics snippet:
```bash
# runtime decode error rate (last 30m)
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/api/metrics?service=runtime&version=3.14.2&metric=decode_error_rate&window=30m" | jq '.value'
```

lina: I'll subscribe an alert: runtime.quant.decode_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> paging oncall. Also adding KV-cache delta alert.

anika: Product question: do we need a customer-facing advisory or release note update? If so I'll draft a short blurb.

maria: Yes please — short advisory saying we temporarily pinned runtime in eu-west for quant models due to decoding regression; no user data exposure, mitigation in progress, ETA 4h. Link to ops note here: https://docs.internal/release-notes/2026-03-21-quant-rollback

anika: Drafted and posted to #marketing-waiting-for-approval. Pinged legal for the standard wording.

raj: One more ops housekeeping: update the central pinlist and the runtime compatibility matrix so oncalls see the pinned mapping. I'll take that: updating /docs/pinlist.md and /runbooks/runtime-compat.md

maria: Perfect. We'll monitor the canary and telemetry. If everything looks green we'll lift the pin early and do a controlled unpin (announce 30m before). If regressions persist we can extend or open a rollback RCA.

kevin: Canary results so far (10m): 
- eu-central: decode_error_rate=0.12% latency_p95_delta=+4ms
- us-east: decode_error_rate=0.08% latency_p95_delta=+3ms
No red flags yet.

lina: Observability shows KV-cache miss delta +0.9% (baseline 0.7%) — tracking but under threshold.

deploy-bot: Reminder: pin will auto-expire at 1760003599 unless extended. Use `POST /api/pins/pin-1759999999-qt/extend` to modify.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll keep a 15m cadence updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
